title: The French Lombard Dataset
why_promising: Primary non-singing French production with synchronized speech and electroglottographic signals from 40 speakers recorded under four white-noise conditions (0/65/75/85 dB SPL), approximately 8 hours and 9,120 clips. The authoritative Zenodo record states 'Recordings and annotation by Maxime Jacquelin' and releases the dataset under CC BY-NC-SA; this is potentially valuable for intensity, voice/EGG, timing, Lombard-condition, speaker, and future segment/prosodic measurements.
open_question: Open and enumerate FLombard.zip at file level before core promotion. Verify exactly which annotation objects are human-created/manual versus derived or automatic, inventory all EGG/audio/annotation/metadata files and checksums, and ingest only demonstrably human-created or exhaustively human-verified annotation/measurement layers. Do not treat the Fharvard sentence-resource lineage as new production data; deduplicate stimulus provenance from the newly recorded French Lombard productions.
